rulesets.m: CRITICAL CAMERA: every cell is drawn in 3/4 TOP-DOWN QUARTER VIEW — camera pitched 30 degrees DOWNWARD and rotated 45 degrees, orthographic; the viewer looks DOWN at the creature. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: pure side profile, pure front view, eye-level view. Match the art style of the reference image EXACTLY: hand-drawn pixel art, same dot size, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. Build the shape from THICK SOLID MASSES readable at 128px tall — no hair-thin details. LAYOUT: an even grid of cells. Every cell holds the SAME creature at the SAME scale and the SAME canvas position with feet on a common baseline; only the pose differs. Do not change the design, proportions or size between cells. No grid lines, no labels, no numbers, no text. COLOR: NEUTRAL DESATURATED GRAY-WHITE only, no hue at all, so a palette tint can be applied later. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF across the whole image, no ground, no floor, no shadow, no scenery.
